description:
Free. Records the user's verdict on a company in their ranked list: good_fit, not_fit or already_talking, with an optional reason from a fixed list (competitor, existing_customer, too_small, too_big, wrong_industry, no_need, bad_timing, other). A not_fit company is left out of every later discover for this workspace; the user's own named list still runs it. The latest verdict per company wins. No free text is stored.
Use when: "that one's a competitor, skip it", "not a fit", "good fit", "we're already talking to them", "drop this company", "mark it as a bad lead", a verdict on an account discover returned.
Skip when: finding or ranking new accounts; excluding a whole category of companies from the ICP (seller_profile); checking an outreach draft. Quoted page text is normalized; a quote that reads like an instruction keeps its text and is flagged in <field>Flags with the attack family.

domain.description: The company's domain, as the ranked list shows it

verdict.description: good_fit, not_fit (it leaves later discovers) or already_talking
